items.markdown:
Copper peptides (GHK-Cu) are `small chains of amino acids bound to copper ions that help signal the skin to produce more collagen and improve elasticity`.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/copper-peptides)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/kvTxIMME-74)

### Key Benefits

- **Boosts Firmness:** Stimulates collagen and elastin production to help smooth fine lines and tighten loose skin.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6073405/)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/copper-peptides)
- **Fights Free Radicals:** Acts as an antioxidant to protect skin cells from environmental stress.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6073405/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:378959402095812392,catalogid:2452231911483610697,gpcid:14315254744359337565,mid:576462460901031824&ibp=oshop)
- **Supports Healing:** Helps repair damaged proteins and calm inflammation in the skin barrier.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6073405/)

### Popular Products

- **The Ordinary:** The [Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1%](https://theordinary.com/en-gb/multi-peptide-copper-peptides-1-serum-100625.html) serum costs around £28.90 and targets fine lines and overall texture.[[1]](https://theordinary.com/en-gb/multi-peptide-copper-peptides-1-serum-100625.html)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:378959402095812392,catalogid:2452231911483610697,gpcid:14315254744359337565,mid:576462460901031824&ibp=oshop)
- **Medik8:** [Copper PCA Peptides Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462722302604465,imageDocid:225679987371259598,gpcid:16766231247814859464,headlineOfferDocid:13211901332436125110,catalogid:14087886674605722570,productDocid:14769407049973634641,rds:CSS_PC_16766231247814859464%7CPC_16766231247814859464%7CPROD_CSS_PC_16766231247814859464%7CPROD_PC_16766231247814859464&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjMjv-JiaqXAxVvhv0HHb89JcUQxa4PegoIAggACAAIJRAD) offers advanced antioxidant protection and usually retails between £56.50 and £75.30.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:14769407049973634641,catalogid:14087886674605722570,gpcid:16766231247814859464,mid:576462722302604465&ibp=oshop)

### How to Use and Precautions

- **Layering:** Avoid mixing copper peptides directly with strong exfoliating acids or pure L-ascorbic acid (strong Vitamin C) in the exact same step, as they can lower each other's effectiveness. Use Vitamin C in the morning and copper peptides at night instead.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_NdLDZf8OgE)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nVRFpcXf5cg&t=129)
- **Expectations:** They work gradually to support skin health, but they are not a quick fix for deep wrinkles.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copper_peptide_GHK-Cu)[[2]](https://www.paulaschoice.co.uk/copper-peptides/ingredient-copper-peptides.html)
